financiamento.title: Financing Calculator
financiamento.description: Simulate your financing using SAC or PRICE systems. View the complete amortization schedule with all installments.
financiamento.priceExplanation: Amortization system with fixed installments. Interest is higher at the beginning and decreases over time, while amortization increases.
financiamento.sacExplanation: Constant Amortization System. Amortization is fixed and installments decrease over time, as interest is calculated on the decreasing outstanding balance.

annualPropertyAppreciation.label: Annual property appreciation
annualPropertyAppreciation.help: Estimated annual property appreciation (e.g., 6% per year). This does not change the installments; it is only used to calculate IRR by comparing what you pay vs the estimated future value of the property.

rentSection.title: Rent Income (Optional)
rentSection.description: If you plan to rent out the property, enter the monthly rent you expect to receive. This income is considered from month 1 and included in the IRR calculation.

monthlyRent.label: Monthly rent
monthlyRent.help: Monthly rent you will receive by renting out the property (month 1). This value is treated as monthly income in the IRR calculation.

annualRentAdjustment.label: Annual rent adjustment (IGPM)
annualRentAdjustment.help: Annual rent adjustment rate (e.g., IGPM). Rent will be adjusted every 12 months by this rate.

table.title: Amortization Schedule
table.hint: Click the <plus></plus> button in any month to add an extra amortization.
table.tip: Tip: Rows highlighted in green indicate months where extra amortizations were applied. Click the badge to edit or remove.

tie.title: It's a tie!
tie.subtitle: Both options have virtually the same net cost

common.openIrrTooltip: Open IRR calculator with these cash flows
common.irrNote: Does not include returns from investing the difference. Only considers property cash flows: installments (and rent, if any) and the final asset value in the last month.
common.investmentHint: Accumulated by investing the monthly difference
common.netProfitExplanation: You ended with the property and still have cash left (rent + investments exceeded payments).
common.netCostFormulaWithRent: Total paid − Rent income − Investment balance (lower is better)
common.netCostFormulaWithoutRent: Total paid − Investment balance (lower is better)

rent.title: Rent income
rent.description: Rent income assumes you rent out the property from month 1. Rent is adjusted annually by IGPM and is included in the IRR calculation.
rent.comparisonNote: Rent income is included in the IRR calculation. With fewer financing months, the total rent received is lower.

irr.title: Return (IRR)
irr.openTooltip: Open IRR calculator with these cash flows
irr.explanationWithRent: Treats the down payment as an outflow in the first month, and the monthly flow as net cash flow = rent − payment; in the last month, adds the estimated future property value as a positive inflow.
irr.explanationWithoutRent: Treats the down payment as an outflow in the first month, and the monthly flow as the payment (outflow); in the last month, adds the estimated future property value as a positive inflow.
irr.extrasExplanationWithRent: Monthly cash flows: down payment (outflow in month 1) and net cash flow = rent − (payment + extra amortizations); in the last month, adds the estimated future property value as a positive inflow.
irr.extrasExplanationWithoutRent: Monthly cash flows: down payment (outflow in month 1) and payments (including extra amortizations) as outflows; in the last month, adds the estimated future property value as a positive inflow.

comparison.subtitle: Comparison between the original financing and financing with extra amortizations

consorcio.title: Consortium Calculator
consorcio.description: Simulate your consortium installments with annual INCC/IPCA correction.

annualAdjustment.label: Annual adjustment
annualAdjustment.help: Consortium installments are adjusted annually by an index such as INCC (real estate) or IPCA. The default 6% is just an estimate. Check your contract for the exact index.

bidAmount.label: Bid amount
bidAmount.help: Bid amount used to anticipate installments and reduce the consortium term. The bid is applied in the contemplation month.

contemplationMonth.label: Contemplation month
contemplationMonth.help: Month when you'll be contemplated and can place a bid. If you bought a pre-contemplated letter, use month 1.

premium.label: Premium for a contemplated letter
premium.help: Amount paid to buy a consortium letter that is already contemplated. This amount is added to total cost and included in the IRR calculation.

lanceAgioError.title: Error:
lanceAgioError.message: Fill in only one of the fields: Bid amount or Premium. These scenarios are mutually exclusive.

lanceAgioNote.title: Note:
lanceAgioNote.message: Bid and Premium represent different scenarios. Use bid if you'll be contemplated via draw/bid. Use premium if you're buying a letter already contemplated from a third party.

rentSection.title: Rent Income (Optional)
rentSection.description: If you plan to rent out the property, enter the monthly rent you expect to receive. Income starts from the contemplation month and is included in the IRR calculation.

monthlyRent.label: Monthly rent
monthlyRent.help: Monthly rent you will receive by renting out the property (month 1). This value is treated as monthly income starting from the contemplation month.

annualRentAdjustment.label: Annual adjustment (IGPM)
annualRentAdjustment.help: Annual rent adjustment (typically IGPM). Applied every 12 months (month 13, 25, ...).

table.title: Installments Table
table.hintWithExtras: Click the <plus></plus> button in any month to add an extra amortization (bid).
table.hintNoExtras: Highlighted rows indicate months where the annual adjustment was applied.
table.tip: Tip: Rows highlighted in green indicate months where extra amortizations were applied. Click the badge to edit or remove.

rent.title: Rent income
rent.description: Rent income assumes you rent out the property starting from the contemplation month. Rent is adjusted annually by IGPM and is included in the IRR calculation as monthly income (it may become positive when rent exceeds the installment).

irr.title: Return (IRR)
irr.openTooltip: Open IRR calculator with these cash flows
irr.explanationWithRent: Each month is treated as net cash flow = rent − installment (it can be positive when rent exceeds the installment), and the final adjusted asset value is added as a positive inflow in the last month.
irr.explanationWithoutRent: Each installment (common fund + admin fee) is treated as a monthly outflow, and the final adjusted asset value is added as a positive inflow in the last month.
irr.extrasExplanationWithRent: Monthly cash flows: net cash flow = rent − installments (including extra amortizations) and the final adjusted asset value as a positive inflow in the last month.
irr.extrasExplanationWithoutRent: Monthly cash flows: installments (including extra amortizations) as outflows and the final adjusted asset value as a positive inflow in the last month.

property.title: Property value
property.note: This value will be used for both scenarios

rent.title: Rent Income (Optional)

investment.title: Invest the difference
investment.note: The monthly difference between installments will be invested at this rate

annualPropertyAppreciation.label: Annual property appreciation
annualPropertyAppreciation.help: Estimated annual property appreciation. Used to calculate financing IRR.

annualAdjustment.label: Annual adjustment (INCC/IPCA)
annualAdjustment.help: Consortium installments are adjusted annually by an index such as INCC or IPCA.

bidAmount.label: Bid amount
bidAmount.help: Amount paid in the contemplation month to anticipate installments. Reduces the outstanding balance and term, saving on admin fees.

contemplationMonth.label: Contemplation month
contemplationMonth.help: Month when you'll be contemplated and receive the credit letter to buy the property. Before that, you pay installments but don't have the asset.

premium.label: Premium for a contemplated letter
premium.help: Amount paid to buy a consortium letter already contemplated. This is added to the initial payment (month 1) and does not change the letter value nor monthly installments.

monthlyRent.label: Monthly rent
monthlyRent.help: Monthly rent you will receive by renting out the property (month 1). This value is treated as monthly income.

annualRentAdjustment.label: Annual adjustment (IGPM)
annualRentAdjustment.help: Annual rent adjustment (typically IGPM). Applied every 12 months (month 13, 25, ...).

annualReturnRate.label: Annual return rate
annualReturnRate.help: Annual return rate you could get by investing the difference between installments. Examples: CDI (~10%), Selic bonds (~10%), CDB (~12%).

lanceAgioError.title: Error:
lanceAgioError.message: Fill in only one of the fields: Bid amount or Premium. These scenarios are mutually exclusive.

lanceAgioNote.title: Note:
lanceAgioNote.message: Bid and Premium are different scenarios. Use bid if you'll be contemplated via draw/bid. Use premium if you're buying a letter already contemplated from a third party.

alugar-vs-comprar.title: Rent vs Buy
alugar-vs-comprar.description: Compare whether it's better to buy a financed property or rent and invest the difference.

annualPropertyAppreciation.label: Annual property appreciation
annualPropertyAppreciation.help: Estimated annual property appreciation (e.g., 5% per year). Used to calculate the future property value in the buy scenario.

annualRentAdjustment.label: Annual rent adjustment (IGPM)
annualRentAdjustment.help: Annual rent adjustment rate (e.g., IGPM). Rent will be adjusted every 12 months by this rate.

annualReturnRate.label: Annual investment return rate
annualReturnRate.help: Expected annual return of the investment where you'll invest the difference between the financing payment and the rent paid.

table.title: Monthly evolution
table.subtitle: Month-by-month comparison of payments, rent paid, invested difference, and accumulated net worth

legend.title: Legend:

legend.negativeDifference: Negative difference: rent is higher than payment (you need extra cash)
legend.rentNetWorthFormula: Invested balance − extra contributions (when rent > payment)

juros-compostos.title: Compound Interest
juros-compostos.description: Calculate the yield of your investments with compound interest over time.

interestRate.label: Interest rate
interestRate.help: Interest rate per period. If you have an annual rate, select "Annual" as the period. The rate will be applied each period.

period.label: Period
period.help: Sets the frequency of interest and contributions. If you have an annual rate of 12%, select "Annual" and enter 12% as the rate.

contribution.label: Periodic contributions
contribution.help: Fixed amount added each period. Leave blank or zero if you don't plan to contribute periodically.
